hero.headline: Built For Men Who Run On Empty
hero.subtext: Stamix is a herbal health supplement for adult men — 17 botanicals, herbs, seeds and nuts, at a full 20 g daily serving. Expertly formulated to support everyday energy, stamina, focus and recovery.

scienceSection.subtitle: TARGETING ROOT FACTORS
scienceSection.title: What Works Against You
scienceSection.intro: These are well-documented factors in how men feel day to day. Stamix is built to support the body through them — it does not treat any of them.

factors.title: Stress Load
factors.description: Sustained stress affects sleep, recovery and energy.

factors.title: Oxidative Stress
factors.description: Pollution, smoking and poor diet generate it; antioxidant-rich foods work against it.

factors.title: Nutritional Gaps
factors.description: Skipped meals and delivery food leave real shortfalls in zinc, magnesium and vitamin E.

factors.title: Poor Sleep
factors.description: Most of the body's recovery work happens in deep sleep.

factors.title: Sedentary Work
factors.description: Long unbroken sitting affects circulation and weight.

factors.title: Age-Related Change
factors.description: Energy and recovery genuinely shift through the thirties and forties.

solutionSection.subtitle: THE STAMIX FORMULA
solutionSection.title: How Stamix Supports You
solutionSection.intro: A deliberate 20 g daily serving of 17 whole botanicals, herbs, seeds and nuts built to provide nutritional foundation for active men.

pillars.title: Supports Daily Energy
pillars.description: Whole-food nutrition and traditional energy botanicals, with no caffeine and no stimulant crash.

pillars.title: Supports Your Stress Response
pillars.description: Ashwagandha and other adaptogenic herbs, traditionally used to help the body cope with sustained stress.

pillars.title: Supports Recovery
pillars.description: Nutritional support for the body's own repair processes, taken at night when most of that work happens.

journeySection.subtitle: THE TRAJECTORY
journeySection.title: Your Daily Progression
journeySection.intro: Natural botanical nutrition works with your daily routine over time, not overnight.

milestones.title: Systemic Introduction
milestones.description: One 10 g scoop, twice daily. Whole Ashwagandha, Shatavari, and Safed Musli start providing foundational whole-root nourishment with zero synthetic jitters.

milestones.title: Steady Day-to-Day Vitality
milestones.description: Consistent micronutrient delivery helps support everyday energy resilience and reduces afternoon sluggishness.

milestones.title: Deeper Rest & Recovery
milestones.description: Nightly intake protocol supports physical relaxation and overnight natural restoration.

milestones.title: Sustained Baseline
milestones.description: Long-term herbal nutrition supports daily endurance, mental focus, and baseline physical vigor.

dailyRitualSection.subtitle: THE DAILY RITUAL
dailyRitualSection.title: Simple Intake Protocol
dailyRitualSection.intro: Two 10 g scoops per day (20 g total). Formulated to blend effortlessly into your morning and evening routines.

steps.title: Morning 10 g Scoop
steps.description: Mix one 10 g scoop with 200ml warm milk or water alongside your breakfast to support morning stamina.

steps.title: Evening 10 g Scoop
steps.description: Take your second 10 g scoop post-dinner or before sleep to support natural nightly rest and restoration.

steps.title: Consistency Compounding
steps.description: Whole botanicals deliver compounding benefits with regular, uninterrupted daily intake.
